_note: Manual review of selected incidents. 'featured' are listed first in the app, in this order. 'reviewed' descriptions were written by a person after watching each clip; the BLIP caption is still shown separately as the AI caption. 'clip_override' sets the incident clip window in seconds [start, end] where the motion-based window missed part of the event (used by phase 11).

reviewed.INC_0001: Several uniformed officers hold a person down on a bench in a holding room while another officer kneels beside them.
reviewed.INC_0007: At a busy road junction a police car pursues a white van; the van cuts across the junction and the police car pulls up against it, stopping it.
reviewed.INC_0010: In a waiting area with rows of chairs, officers grapple with a man and force him to the floor while other people look on.
reviewed.INC_0020: At night outside a bar (01:23 on the camera clock), a man in a white shirt attacks another man, who falls to the ground while bystanders watch.
reviewed.INC_0029: In a building entrance beside the glass doors, a man in a cap tackles another man and the two grapple on the floor.
reviewed.INC_0035: A fight breaks out in a busy fast-food restaurant: a man is knocked to the floor, objects are thrown and customers move away.
reviewed.INC_0036: In a gravel car park, a pickup truck reverses across the lot towards a parked silver car while two pedestrians walk past.
reviewed.INC_0038: Masked robbers raid a convenience store; one swings a bat towards a person at the door while another stays behind the counter.
reviewed.INC_0039: A man in a blue helmet lunges at two women leaving a gated entrance and knocks one to the ground in an apparent bag snatch; a man in a cap then runs after him.
reviewed.INC_0045: A car drives past a pavement flower stall, stops a little further along the street and its boot is opened.
